senses.gloss: ch.<cite ref="P00940">same</cite> <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 28:28">Targ. Y. Ex. XXVIII, 28</cite> Ar. (ed. <he>ויטכס׳</he>; h. text <he>וירכסו</he>).—
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 97a:3">Erub. 97ᵃ</cite> <he>לִיעַנְבִינְהוּ מִיעֲנַב</he> let him fasten them with a loop.
<cite ref="Sukkah 33b:13">Succ. 33ᵇ</cite> <he>לִיעַנְבֵיה מיענב</he> let him tie it (the Lulab) &c.
<cite ref="Menachot 38b:11">Men. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>לעַנְבָן כולהו בהדדי</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 40) to make a loop of all of them together; a. e.

senses.gloss: to be looped. Ib. אלימי דלא מִיעַנְבֵי ואי הוו קטיני מיענבי if the threads are too thick to allow a loop, but long enough to be looped if they were thinner; a. e.
